## How it works

- [statement] The base fee is signature_count x lamports_per_signature, with lamports_per_signature fixed at 5,000. signature_count includes the transaction's Ed25519 signatures plus signatures checked by the Ed25519, Secp256k1 and (when enabled) Secp256r1 precompiles. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-12) — https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/fee-structure.mdx · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit · also: https://solanacompass.com/news/solana-validators-debate-simd-0550-and-simd-0553-as-sol-issuance-cuts-near, https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0553-resource-fee-burn.md
- [statement] Worked overpay example: a swap that consumed 75,000 CUs but declared 1,400,000 CUs at 50,000 micro-lamports/CU paid a 70,000-lamport priority fee. Oversized limits can also make the scheduler defer a transaction when a hot account nears its per-block write-lock CU cap. The author sells a swap-routing product. (low confidence) — https://dev.to/verixia_233e4721792ce3390/optimizing-solana-compute-unit-limits-for-swap-execution-3di4 · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit
- [statement] A transaction pays its fee even when it fails. The fee is deducted from the fee payer before execution, and a transaction that fails while loading accounts can still be committed as fee-only (ProcessedTransaction::FeesOnly in Agave): the payer is debited the full total fee although nothing executes. Firedancer carries the same case as the flag FD_TXN_P_FLAGS_FEES_ONLY. (high confidence) — https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/fee-structure.mdx · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit · also: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0553-resource-fee-burn.md, https://github.com/firedancer-io/firedancer/blob/e048bdf3558ad942ff8b07ac4f3a2c4b0f2cb674/src/disco/pack/fd_pack.h

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Half of the base fee is burned and the other half goes to the block leader. Since SIMD-0096 (status Activated) the leader also receives 100% of the priority fee, so validator reward = base_fee/2 + prioritization_fee. Before SIMD-0096 the priority fee was also split 50/50 burn/leader. (high confidence) — https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/fee-structure.mdx · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit · also: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0096-reward-collected-priority-fee-in-entirety.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The scheduler ranks transactions by priority = reward x 1,000,000 / (cost + 1). Reward is the priority fee plus the non-burned half of the base fee. Cost is the scheduler's estimate: signature cost + write-lock cost + instruction-data cost + the requested CU limit (programs execution cost) + loaded-accounts data cost. Agave's own comment says the +1 only avoids division by zero. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://github.com/anza-xyz/agave/blob/352af81a3bf3a7b9a52457b059021f927fe95294/core/src/transaction_priority.rs · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit · also: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/fee-structure.mdx, https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/compute-budget.mdx

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The runtime deducts the total fee from the fee payer before execution, and the fee stays charged if the transaction fails. A transaction that fails while loading accounts is processed as fee-only (ProcessedTransaction::FeesOnly), and the payer is still debited the full fee. (high confidence) — https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-com/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/en/core/fees/fee-structure.mdx · keywords: Solana base fee and compute unit price and limit · also: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0553-resource-fee-burn.md, https://madeonsol.com/blog/solana-transaction-fees-explained
